about.projectSectionText: This app is a fully personal project with no commercial purpose. Making the project open source is planned for a later stage.
bugsSectionBullets: When word-by-word translation is enabled, verses without word meanings show nothing, e.g. the first verse of Inshirah
A Quran page view will be added
Page audio will be added; audio also needs to be generated for the shorter surahs on the page in juz 30

bullets: About screen: added a language selector and a theme selector.
The theme selector is now fixed in the top bar on every screen; you can switch between light, dark and lights-out modes.
Rebuilt how settings, user data and forum data are fetched and updated; data now syncs more reliably.
In-app text is now managed from translation files (tr.json/en.json); the changelog moved here too.
My Duas: fixed deleting a dua and rejecting a dua request.
Translation update: the download no longer failed to start when answering "No"; the update button is now hidden when data is already current.
PWA back button: the Android back button used to exit the app, it now navigates back within the app instead.
Font selection: added a separate Arabic font choice for Quran reading and for share images; font size can now be adjusted with A+/A- on the image preview screen.
Main menu: removed the settings icon from the top right.
Surah view: opening a verse from a bookmark now scrolls to the correct verse.
Hijri calendar: designed and added a calendar page (thanks MHS).
Main menu: switched to a grid layout.
Top bar: made the top menu smaller.
Uzbek translations: added new Uzbek (Cyrillic) and Uzbek (Latin) translations.
Translation data: translation files are now gzip-compressed, dropping the download from 80 MB to 20 MB (thanks 'kucukaslan').
Reciter removed: Minshawi Mujawwad was temporarily disabled due to recitation issues (thanks 'ssargin'). See video: https://youtu.be/dveu8DRo5Rk?si=oT3qaBZzKP8gydGG
Random verse page now shows the download screen when data is missing.
Search page now shows the download screen when data is missing.
Moved the download screen into a shared component.
Moved the download logic into a shared hook.
Search input is now normalized with fuzzy highlighting.
Fixed a rendering issue with the medli esre mark in Arabic text (thanks 'ferdogan').
Umrah support: added a "Where am I now?" screen to track tawaf and sa'y.
My Duas: added personal and on-behalf-of-others dua checklists.
Umrah duas: added a guide covering ihram, tawaf, sa'y and other umrah worship duas.
Checklist: added outbound/return flight info, a platform-aware date picker (web/mobile), and automatic Skyscanner integration.
PWA support: the web app can now be installed as a Progressive Web App and works offline.
New translations: added Kurdish (Kurmanji) Latin and Arabic-script Diyanet translations, plus the Ömer Çelik translation.
Data infrastructure: added version-based dynamic translation listing and a new processing engine for large data files.
Hatim page: added an interactive hatim system so users can complete a Quran reading together.
Prayer times: added location-aware prayer times covering every province and district in Turkey for 2025.
Friday sermon: added a dedicated section for reading the weekly Friday sermon as a PDF.
Location services: integrated GPS-based automatic location detection and manual city/district selection.
Added SQLite database support (Android/iOS)
Fast lookups via a composite (surah, verse) primary key
Transaction-based batch insert operations
Rebuilt the IndexedDB data structure - verses are now stored individually
Download progress bar now shows real-time byte counts
Added search to the surah list
Improved URL structure - the verse being read now shows in the URL
Updated the random verse and remove-favorite emojis
Fixed a bug with the remove-favorite button
Fixed AsyncStorage size limit issues
Performance improvements and memory optimization
Fixed scrolling on the random verse page
Fixed an audio preview bug
Shrunk the header and footer, removed the instruction text below
Added a "show all translations" button
Added sharing a verse with a different translation from the show-all-translations page
Added a home button to every page
Added different modes and sizes when generating share images
Added Google Analytics
Added verse sharing
Added sharing verses as images
Added dark mode verse sharing
Added a random verse page
Added a "verse by verse" option to memorization mode
Added audio preview when choosing a reciter
Added a dynamic page indicator in paginated view
Added a total verse count to the go-to-verse button
Fixed favorite translation support in the go-to-verse modal
Added release notes to the About screen
Added new reciters
Added a repeat count option to memorization mode
Audio player performance improvements
UI improvements and bug fixes
